claim: Fix plan-app status mis-bucketing: PlanApp.Sources.Plans.classify/1 matches the bucket regexes against the START of the **Status:** value (^superseded, ^done, ...), so a non-canonical header like 'largely superseded (2026-06)' falls through to :pending and a superseded plan renders as live work. Either canonicalize status headers to a leading keyword, or loosen classify to recognize the keyword anywhere in the value (carefully, to avoid false positives). Observed on cb-direction/plans/composable-beliefs-plans.md, which is largely superseded but buckets pending.

evidence.detail: Observed when confirming the cb-direction registry render: the one cb-direction plan is headed 'Status: largely superseded' yet surfaced in the pending bucket. classify/1 anchors each pattern with ^, so only a value beginning with the keyword classifies. A latent correctness gap for any non-canonical status string, not specific to this plan. Tag-overlap review: plan-app backlog family only; no existing directive covers status parsing, so no conflict.
